avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune stimulant may counteract secukinumab's immunosuppressive effects and reduce therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue echinacea use; consult physician before use during secukinumab therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Astragalus
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulant properties may antagonize IL-17A inhibition and compromise treatment efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discuss alternative immune support with healthcare provider

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune activation, potentially reducing secukinumab efficacy in autoimmune conditions
avoid_supplements.action: Use with caution or avoid; monitor disease activity closely if concurrent use is necessary

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate immune response; monitor for changes in disease control
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; select well-studied strains and monitor therapeutic response

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Supports immune homeostasis; deficiency common in autoimmune diseases; may be beneficial
caution_supplements.action: Maintain adequate vitamin D levels with monitoring; supplementation generally supportive

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate inflammatory responses in certain autoimmune conditions; not a direct drug interaction
caution_foods.action: Moderate sodium intake as part of general autoimmune disease management

monitoring_notes: Secukinumab is a biologic agent with minimal direct food-drug interactions, but immune-stimulating supplements should be avoided to prevent antagonism of therapeutic effects. Monitor for increased infection risk due to IL-17A inhibition, which impairs mucosal immunity; counsel patients on signs of infection and vaccine considerations.
